decisions.reason: The XL package is a direct extension of the established anamnesis app for larger practices, so it builds on existing know-how and in-house development, its results are easy to interpret, and it is cheap to maintain.

Materials management fits naturally into the practice-management suite and draws on the firm's deep dental-workflow knowledge, so the firm can learn from user feedback and improve it in-house, even though it received little website emphasis.

The KIM messaging client is a regulatory telematics component that builds on the firm's compliance and health-IT expertise, is continuously updated in-house, and is essential for customers, so dropping it would be implausible.
